statement: Core context concepts are shared by all supported performance domains.
FC extensions must not depend on each other; shared concepts belong in the core.
FC model extensions cannot depend on platform-owned common extensions.
A logical lot can span carriers and a carrier can contain wafers from multiple lots.
A process step can be instantiated by multiple equipment-specific process jobs.
Wafer-level and higher context is stored in the Analytics PostgreSQL inventory.
Warehouse datasets persist wafer-level and sub-wafer context in context columns.
A dataset context-column name is a path from a job anchor to an entity attribute.
Context-column paths use lowercase characters and underscores for Spark compatibility.
Backward-incompatible context changes can require customer migration or re-ingestion and should be avoided.
Runtime context-model extension support is not covered by this model version.
Canonical identifier names use key prefix and Id suffix; backend-normalized IDs also use Key.
Associating identifiers need not be unique and require additional context.
Normalization maps a source associating identifier to a canonical target identifier.
Associating ID names use the entity name and Id suffix.
Do not repeat an entity name in its own attribute names; Job uses id rather than JobId.
White combined-key entities are platform computed for cross-layer job identity.
Inventory and plugins must store supplied enum values, not enum constant names.
ADEL is the authority for ADEL-derived enum values unless a justified deviation exists.
Platform-created enum constants and values use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.
Store Waferstage chuck ID 1 or Waferstage chuck ID 2, not CHUCK_1 or CHUCK_2.
Process-job recipes come from ADELler LotSettings/ExposureRecipeId or ADELMetrology Input/RecipeInformation/Name; compute-job recipes come from the data plugin.
ExposureProcessJob inherits Job.id from ADELler LotId.
Exposure waferProcessingOrder comes from ADELler; measurement order is calculated by LANA.
WaferExposureProcessJob.waferSequenceNr is between 1 and 25 inclusive.
Exposure lot reworked defaults to false until the lot is reworked.
Exposure wafer reworked defaults to false until reworked or re-exposed.
latestReworked identifies the most recent already-reworked lot, excluding a last exposure that has never been reworked.
Data plugins populate wafer layouts and choose the associated main process job.
Die layout is independent of image configuration and field layout.
Every intrafield point is associated with a field and uses field coordinates.
Interfield positions use wafer coordinates independently of exposure layouts.
Flatten Position context into separate position_X and position_Y paths rather than a complex type.
Flatten Dimensions context into dimensions_height and dimensions_width paths.
ExposedField context is available only for exposure-job data.
Documented database diagrams expose core context, not the complete database schema or all table columns.
Use relation names in canonical paths when multiple relationships connect the same entities.
A LIS job has only one JobReport document; its key maps to job_report_id.
Frontend labels for domain extensions belong in their corresponding SEG documents.
Imported or processed performance data receives context through instances of domain entities.
Domain models must comply with the common meta model defined in D000987766.
The platform must provide a core wafer-fabrication process domain model.
Plugins can extend the core model with domain entities, attributes, and relations.
Each performance domain has a platform-fixed namespace for model extensions.
Customer key-value context can extend process jobs or process-job/wafer combinations without platform-specific semantics.
Domains register relevant context paths and user-facing labels.
Proposed validation prevents distinct context paths from identifying the same attribute.
Users can tag an active fine selection, attaching context to selected KPI values or selected context combinations.
Tagged context has workspace or user scope and private/public asset-management behavior.
User-defined context must be usable in inventory and warehouse slicing.
Context naming consistency and non-duplication are governed using Collibra model definitions.
Represent record health and KPI validity using context attributes.
Boolean validity and record health require dedicated visualization controls.
Inventory stores public and private wafer-level and higher context, including processing and tags.
Sub-wafer context is stored only in the data warehouse, not inventory.
The warehouse duplicates the inventory context subset needed for visualization and processing.
Breaking context-model changes require a semantic-version update and stakeholder review of the EPS.
KPI columns are not context-model paths; GroupByContext and MaxGranularity associate them with context columns.
The current direction puts shared sub-wafer concepts in a common package; future revision is still required.
Flow was removed because the platform did not support it.
ProcessJobId and WaferProcessJobId are composite domain identifiers. Numeric relational id columns are internal database identifiers. These identifier categories are not interchangeable.
